# THE THIRD-PARTY IMAGES THE STACKS USE, AND WHERE THEIR COPIES LIVE.
#
# Every image the four compose files (docker-compose-run-tests.yml,
# docker-compose.yml, local-tests.yml, keycloak-tests.yml, and the overlays on
# top of them) pull or build FROM is copied into a PRIVATE package under
#
#   ghcr.io/rcbj/id-proto-debugger/mirror/<mirror path>
#
# by .github/workflows/mirror-images.yml, and the stack pulls it from there
# rather than from Docker Hub or quay.io. On 2026-09-27 the scheduled run
# died three seconds in because a token request to auth.docker.io was reset;
# with the copies here, the upstream registries are touched only when an
# image is missing from the mirror or on the weekly refresh.
#
# Two columns: the upstream reference, and its path under the mirror prefix
# (IMAGE_MIRROR in the compose file). A line here is used in one of two ways:
#
#   * an `image:` in the compose file, written as
#       ${IMAGE_MIRROR:-...}/<mirror path>
#   * a base image some Dockerfile names in a FROM, redirected by an entry in
#     that service's build.additional_contexts (or a --build-context where a
#     Dockerfile is built outside compose).
#
# Images with no upstream are BUILT into the same mirror instead, and listed
# in .github/image-mirror-builds.txt rather than here: that list's columns
# are a mirror path and a source, not an upstream.
#
# tests/image_mirror_coverage.js fails when a FROM or an `image:` in any of
# those compose files is not covered here, so a new base image cannot silently go back to
# Docker Hub. Add it here in the same commit, and the next test run's mirror
# job copies it before the stack is built.
#
# upstream                               mirror path
ubuntu:latest                            ubuntu:latest
node:24.22.1-alpine                      node:24.22.1-alpine
node:24.22.1-bookworm-slim               node:24.22.1-bookworm-slim
eclipse-temurin:11-jdk                   eclipse-temurin:11-jdk
postgres:18                              postgres:18
quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.6.4         keycloak/keycloak:26.6.4
waltid/issuer-api2:0.23.0                waltid/issuer-api2:0.23.0
waltid/verifier-api2:0.23.0              waltid/verifier-api2:0.23.0
# iya-sts's own release image, published PUBLIC by iya-sts's pipeline. The
# stacks run this private copy so a run depends on no package outside this
# repository's area; the weekly refresh re-copies the tag. A release bump
# changes this line together with the IYA_STS_IMAGE defaults in the compose
# files, which tests/image_mirror_coverage.js holds to it.
ghcr.io/rcbj/iya-sts:1.0.0               iya-sts:1.0.0
